# CascadingDirnameCalls

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.0" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `CascadingDirnameCallsInspection`

Since PHP 7.0 `dirname()` accepts a second "levels" argument, so a chain of
nested `dirname()` calls can be collapsed into a single call with the summed
level count: fewer calls, easier to read.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5,6,7} [Before]
<?php
$base = dirname(dirname(dirname($root)));
$app  = dirname(dirname(dirname(dirname(getcwd()))));
$var  = dirname(dirname($root, $up));
$sum  = dirname(dirname($root, 2), 3);
$two  = dirname(dirname($root, $a), $b);
$fq   = \dirname(\dirname($root));

// not reported
$one  = dirname($root);
$lvl  = dirname($root, 1);
$far  = dirname($root, 4);
$wrap = dirname(getcwd());
$real = dirname(realpath($root), 2);
$zero = dirname(dirname($root, 0));
$bad  = dirname(dirname());
$none = dirname();
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$base = dirname($root, 3);
$app  = dirname(getcwd(), 4);
$var  = dirname($root, 1 + $up);
$sum  = dirname($root, 5);
$two  = dirname($root, 0 + $b + $a);
$fq   = dirname($root, 2);

// not reported
$one  = dirname($root);
$lvl  = dirname($root, 1);
$far  = dirname($root, 4);
$wrap = dirname(getcwd());
$real = dirname(realpath($root), 2);
$zero = dirname(dirname($root, 0));
$bad  = dirname(dirname());
$none = dirname();
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Collapse the nested dirname() calls into &#39;dirname($root, 3)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Collapse the nested dirname() calls into &#39;dirname(getcwd(), 4)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Collapse the nested dirname() calls into &#39;dirname($root, 1 + $up)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Collapse the nested dirname() calls into &#39;dirname($root, 5)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Collapse the nested dirname() calls into &#39;dirname($root, 0 + $b + $a)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Collapse the nested dirname() calls into &#39;dirname($root, 2)&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "CascadingDirnameCalls": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore CascadingDirnameCalls

/**
 * @noinspection CascadingDirnameCallsInspection
 */
```
